changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla ai_embeddings: vectores de 768 dimensiones de temas, perfiles, videos y fragmentos (la escribe ai/; sin auditoría). Incluye secuencia propia (sin tabla de auditoría: tabla de volumen alto o de solo inserción).

createTable.remarks: Embeddings of topics, profiles, videos and chunks (vector(768), ADR 0012). Written by the ai service. No audit table

column.name: owner_type
column.remarks: Kind of the owner: topic, profile, video or chunk

column.name: owner_id
column.remarks: Id of the owner in its table (topics, enrollments, video_candidates or document_chunks)

column.name: model
column.remarks: Embedding model; vectors of different models must not be compared

column.name: content_sha256
column.remarks: SHA-256 of the embedded content, to skip unchanged content

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ai_embeddings ADD CONSTRAINT ai_embeddings_owner_type_ck CHECK (owner_type IN ('topic', 'profile', 'video', 'chunk'))
CREATE TRIGGER ai_embeddings_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON ai_embeddings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
